VERDICTS (VLM-reviewed): t0 reproduces his favorite look; t1 Teegra (retro-fantasy only) = convincing vintage sword-and-sorcery film still (black hair, light-blue wrap, gold jewelry, muted earth+cool blue); t2 same + jada LoRA = IDENTITY HIJACK, face becomes a photo-real celebrity (Megan Fox-like) -> character LoRAs must stay OFF for FNI characters; t3 Darkwolf = towering war-painted axe warrior with horned helm/dark cloak, excellent; t4 Larn = young bronze-sword warrior, good. Krea 2 probe batches b+c on the 4090 (probes/krea_4090_batches.py, supersedes krea_4090_test.py; outputs renders/4090/krea-80sfantasy/). b = setup plates: s05_filmic EXCELLENT H3 plate (photographed-set feel, no people, warm torch vs cool shadow zones); s05_painted FAILED the painting variable - 'oil painting, thick brushstrokes' text does NOT overcome the retro-fantasy film-still bias, painted set-pieces need a painting-style LoRA/base; s06_cavern good (warm pool foreground right + cold blue receding, no people); icepeak strong Minas-Morgul-ish establishing shot but 'no people' violated (robed procession) + bone piles. c = identity + style A/B: text-only Teegra description holds ATTRIBUTES across seeds (black hair, fair skin, light eyes, mint-blue garment, gold jewelry, barefoot) but is a different woman each seed (eyes blue vs green/hazel, face oval vs heart, hair wavy vs straight) -> real consistency needs ref-image conditioning or per-character seed lock. Style LoRA A/B on same seed: +30sTechnicolor = most saturated teal/gold, Conan-1982 treasure-vault drama, best fit for the technicolor direction; +80sFantasy = Conan/Clash-of-Titans jungle-ruin vintage grade; +retro-80s = WRONG subgenre (Flash Gordon sci-fi, gold machinery, adds background people) - drop it from the FNI stack.
